stories.date_evidence: Reported Sunday 22 Nov 2026 (COP31 closing day, Antalya)
stories.deck: The UN summit in Antalya, Turkey, ends after the longest talks in its history. The EU and about 130 parties reject a final draft that omits fossil fuels; Pacific island nations voice despair.
stories.headline: COP31 collapses: climate talks end with no deal
stories.source: One Turn daily edition 22 Nov 2026; BBC; Al Jazeera

stories.date_evidence: Zelensky statement and Libyan officials' reports, Sunday 22 Nov 2026
stories.deck: President Zelensky says seven Ukrainian sea drones sank the corvette Merkury at Benghazi, Libya, and hit a second vessel. Ten people were injured. The Kremlin says it took note.
stories.headline: Ukraine sinks Russian warship at Libyan port
stories.source: One Turn daily edition 22 Nov 2026; BBC; The Guardian

stories.date_evidence: Strike on Sunday night 22 Nov 2026, BBC report 22:37
stories.deck: A drone strike partly collapses a five-storey block north of Kyiv. Rescuers pull a 7-year-old boy alive after 14 hours.
stories.headline: Russian strike on flats in Dymer kills at least 11

stories.deck: Unknown projectiles strike two tankers near the strait; Bahrain says an Iranian attack on a factory injures two.
stories.headline: Two tankers hit near Strait of Hormuz
stories.source: Russell Record daily headlines 22 Nov 2026; Open Chronicle

stories.deck: Tehran calls a US naval blockade military aggression and says it will counter it by all available means.
stories.headline: Iran vows 'all means' against US blockade

stories.deck: Ukraine's president defends the strikes as he meets Britain's Wes Streeting in Kyiv.
stories.headline: Zelensky: Crimean Bridge strikes a 'fair response'

stories.deck: Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot denounces suspected settler attacks on Palestinian communities across the West Bank.
stories.headline: West Bank settler attacks condemned as 'Jewish terrorism'

stories.deck: Two people are killed in Gaza as settler attacks spread across the West Bank.
stories.headline: Israeli forces kill 2 in Gaza

stories.deck: Finnish defence forces say Ukraine was likely behind the drone strike on Saturday. Kyiv has yet to comment.
stories.headline: Russia-bound ship towed away after Gulf of Finland attack

stories.deck: Democrats secure at least 258 House seats after Chuck Hubbard beats Virginia Foxx in a North Carolina recount.
stories.headline: Democrats win largest House majority since 1992

stories.deck: Theresa May tells the BBC's Laura Kuenssberg that 'Brexit is done' as she attacks Andy Burnham's EU plans.
stories.headline: UK-EU deal row: May 'aghast', Tories vow to scrap it

stories.deck: Nepal's prime minister arrives in India for a two-day state visit at Narendra Modi's invitation.
stories.headline: Nepal PM Balendra Shah begins India visit

stories.deck: Military commanders conclude a second round of talks over tensions along the Arunachal Pradesh frontier.
stories.headline: India and China hold fresh border talks

stories.deck: Choi Kyo-jin resigns after measures to stop AI-assisted cheating in the college entrance exam cause chaos.
stories.headline: South Korea education minister quits over exam chaos

stories.deck: The FBI investigates a reported intrusion into the National Crime Information Center, used by police nationwide.
stories.headline: FBI investigates apparent hack of crime database

stories.deck: The Army will use emergency powers to ignore a court order and detonate tonnes of unstable lead azide by Tuesday.
stories.headline: US Army to detonate explosives in Iowa despite court order

stories.deck: Masked ICE agents take two people at a crowded Seattle airport; interfaith activists protest in Gilroy, California.
stories.headline: ICE agents seize two at Seattle airport; Gilroy protests

stories.deck: The president says he will work with Democrats on a proposed 10% cap on credit-card interest rates.
stories.headline: Trump backs 10% credit-card interest cap

stories.deck: A fire at a confectionery factory in Cikande, Banten, kills at least three people and leaves 36 missing.
stories.headline: Candy factory fire in Banten: 3 dead, dozens missing

stories.deck: A boat carrying mourners to a funeral capsizes in Nigeria, drowning dozens of passengers.
stories.headline: Dozens drown as boat capsizes in Nigeria
stories.source: Al Jazeera via liveworlddaily briefing, 22 Nov 2026

stories.deck: Coastal communities go on alert as the largest swell in years reaches the California coast.
stories.headline: California braces for biggest waves in years
stories.source: The Guardian via liveworlddaily briefing, 22 Nov 2026

stories.deck: The singer marries her partner of four years in a California ceremony. The couple were engaged in 2025.
stories.headline: Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando

stories.deck: The Italian jeweller and businessman, a leading figure of the Bulgari house, dies at 89.
stories.headline: Jeweller Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89

stories.deck: The NHS begins a trial to test whether AI can spot breast cancer earlier, the largest of its kind in the world.
stories.headline: NHS launches world's largest AI breast-cancer trial

stories.deck: The RAF chief says the next fighter jet could be the last crewed combat aircraft, as drones take over more roles.
stories.headline: RAF: next fighter jet may be last crewed combat plane

stories.deck: The AI boom shows signs of unravelling, with insiders floating a taxpayer bailout as tech shares slide.
stories.headline: AI boom wobbles as bailout talk surfaces

stories.deck: The British Gas owner's chief warns more people will be unable to pay energy bills when prices jump in the new year.
stories.headline: Centrica boss 'hugely concerned' over energy bills
